facts.fact: Equatorial Guinea's Interministerial Council, chaired by the Prime Minister on 23 November 2026, approved the normative initiative on Cybersecurity and Information Security as a draft text; the article does not say whether it is a bill or a decree.
facts.system: Ciberseguridad y Seguridad de la Informacion initiative

GNQ.note: The document names no data protection law, bill or authority.
A digital services initiative is approved as a draft, but the document does not say it covers electronic transactions or online selling.
Only a draft decree on shared access to electronic-communications infrastructure is named; no backbone contract, works or service stated.
